title: Condensed Verdier biduality by finite truncation
statement: For a prime ell and a positive-characteristic field k with characteristic different from ell, let X be separated of finite type over k and a:X -> Spec k its structure morphism in Over(Spec k). The specified canonical Verdier biduality map of every bounded constructible complex over the finite-subextension-valued condensed Qbar_ell coefficient ring is invertible.

source.place: Coefficient-biduality paragraph, formal finite-truncation reduction to constructible sheaves

proof.text: Set Q(M)=IsConstructibleModuleObject R M. The existing constructible_of_iso theorem gives its isomorphism invariance. The geometric sheaf lemma gives canonical ambient biduality for singleFunctor M 0 with Q(M).
Apply biduality_of_bounded_heart to the underlying dualizing complex and K. Its boundedness and constructible-homology hypotheses are precisely the two components of K.property.

The monoidal closed structure and braiding of the full bounded-constructible subcategory are restrictions of the ambient ones. Under the inclusion, verdierBiduality is definitionally toIhomIhom. The inclusion reflects isomorphisms, so the ambient isomorphism proves the unchanged original theorem.
